column1: # ui render/style batch (GlTexture / ShaderProgram / style copies / Checkbox)
# GlTexture: a = optional libgdx Texture, b = the GL texture name, c/d = width/height.
#   The private a(FileHandle) reads a whole file into a Pixmap -> loadPixmap ;
#   a() returns the GL name (and throws for the libgdx-backed case) -> getGlId ;
#   b()/c() -> getWidth/getHeight (FrameBuffer passes them to its constructor) ;
#   d() binds -> bind ; e() disposes -> dispose.
# ShaderProgram: a/b = vertex/fragment shader names, c = program name. The string overloads resolve
#   getUniformLocation ; the private a(int,String) compiles one shader -> compileShader ;
#   the private a(int,int) links two shaders -> linkProgram ; a() -> bind (glUseProgram) ;
# ButtonStyle / CheckboxStyle / ScrollBarStyle / TextureRegion / NinePatch: each a() deep-copies
#   every array and scalar into a fresh instance; the synthetic clone() bridges to it, so the real
# Checkbox: the single accessor writes the checked flag that handleInput toggles -> setChecked.
